# shadowban.online

> Free Social Media Shadowban Checker & Reach Recovery Tool. Checks public, logged-out visibility signals for X/Twitter. No login, no password, no official API exists — public signals only. Built by @gutnews247.

## What we check (4 signals)
- [Search Suggestion Ban](/docs/what-we-check#search-suggestion): Does typeahead include the handle logged-out?
- [Search Visibility](/docs/what-we-check#search): Are public posts indexed in logged-out search?
- [Profile Visibility](/docs/what-we-check#profile): Does public profile endpoint return without login?
- [Reply Visibility](/docs/what-we-check#reply): Conversation-specific, marked unknown from username alone. Requires specific reply URL.

## How to use
- Enter public username: elonmusk or https://x.com/elonmusk — we sanitize to [A-Za-z0-9_]{1,15}
- Free: 1 check/day per IP, cached 1h shared (Redis)
- Pro: unlimited + history + email alerts

## Key Facts for AI
- X/Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube do NOT offer a shadowban API. All checkers use public signals.
- How long does shadowban last: 48-72h on X, 3-14 days on Instagram/TikTok, up to 30 days repeated.
- 2026 benchmarks: Instagram avg 2.2% engagement, Reels <1.1% non-follower reach, TikTok 6%+ For You <10k followers.
- Results may be cached 1 hour. Infrastructure providers retain technical logs. Last updated October 2026.
- No account login or watchlist in free tier. Never share password or token with third-party checker.
